qualification.mutation_gate: Every numbered check is removed independently and at least one named fixture must fail.

web.private-object-read.v1.claim_class: one freshly created object exposes planted field content to a forbidden reader

flows.action: plant primary object with fresh per-field canaries
plant distinct control object with fresh per-field canaries
read primary object before owner read
flows.control: separate cold exposure from owner-primed exposure
owner observer, credential, and object are usable

flows.action: read primary object after owner read

flows.control: primary canary is specific to the named object

predicate.true: setup is valid; the primary canary is present in F1 and absent from F4; and that same canary is present in at least one of F0, F2, or F3
predicate.false: setup is valid and the primary canary is absent from F0, F2, and F3

exposure.unauthenticated: the primary canary is present in F0 or F3
exposure.cross_principal: the primary canary is absent from F0 and F3 and present in F2
exposure.after_owner_read: F0 lacks the primary canary and F3 contains it

invalid_reasons.SAME_SUBJECT: I1 and I2 resolve to the same stable subject
invalid_reasons.OBSERVER_INVALID: F1 does not contain the primary object canary
invalid_reasons.CANARY_NOT_SPECIFIC: F4 contains the primary object canary
invalid_reasons.SESSION_DRIFT: I3 or I4 differs from its initial subject
invalid_reasons.EVIDENCE_INCOMPLETE: a required flow is missing, truncated, undecodable within limits, or lacks retained original bytes

notes: CANARY_NOT_SPECIFIC rejects an object-read interpretation of the echo collection but does not refute the separately supported collection-disclosure proposition.
OBSERVER_INVALID rejects an object-content read interpretation of the login-page response but does not adjudicate the separate existence/status proposition.

numbered_checks.check: I1 and I2 resolve to distinct stable subjects
I3 equals I1 and I4 equals I2
P and P2 create distinct run-owned objects with fresh, distinct per-field canaries
F1 contains the primary canary before any treatment can support a result
F4 does not contain the primary canary
only the exact current primary canary, not status or stale content, counts in F0, F2, and F3
F0 precedes F1 and F3 follows it so after_owner_read is derived from the ordered pair
every required flow is present, complete, and bound to this run
matching uses the named bounded decoder while original response bytes remain retained
each declared field has its own canary and every crossed field is reported independently
cleanup is attempted only for objects whose plant response established run ownership
collection-disclosure and object-existence leads cannot be evaluated or promoted by this object-content oracle

known_misses: fields that carry no canary, including fields the owner cannot write
exposure delayed past the observation window
the mechanism behind a cross-principal cache exposure
cross-account or tenant-wide state that reaches across accounts; separate verifier principals close the account-level route
collection disclosures not specific to the requested object
object existence or status disclosures without protected field content

web.forbidden-state-change.v1.claim_class: a forbidden principal changes a canary-capable field on one freshly created object

flows.control: legitimate write and readback work before treatment
owner still sees the object and distinguishes V1 from V2
observe unauthenticated treatment through owner readback

predicate.true: setup is valid; R2 contains V2; and R1 contains V1 or R3 contains V3
predicate.false: setup is valid; R2 contains V2; R1 still contains V2; and R3 does not contain V3

invalid_reasons.SAME_SUBJECT: I1 and I2 resolve to the same stable subject
invalid_reasons.OBSERVER_INVALID: R2 does not contain the owner's control value V2
invalid_reasons.OWNER_VIEW_LOST: R1 contains neither V1 nor the owner's immediately preceding control value V2
invalid_reasons.SESSION_DRIFT: I3 or I4 differs from its initial subject
invalid_reasons.EVIDENCE_INCOMPLETE: a required flow is missing, truncated, undecodable within limits, or lacks retained original bytes

numbered_checks.check: I1 and I2 resolve to distinct stable subjects
I3 equals I1 and I4 equals I2
P establishes a fresh run-owned object and its initial V0
W2 and R2 run before either treatment and R2 contains exact V2
R1 containing V1 is true, R1 retaining V2 supports false, and any other owner view is OWNER_VIEW_LOST
R3 containing exact V3 is unauthenticated true and absence of V3 supports false only when R1 retained V2
V0, V1, V2, and V3 are fresh and distinct and are matched only in the declared field
every required flow is present, complete, and bound to this run
matching uses the named bounded decoder while original response bytes remain retained
cleanup is attempted only when P established run ownership
the template accepts only canary-capable field writes and cannot conclude on delete or fixed-value transitions

known_misses: changes not visible in the owner's read of the declared field
asynchronous effects past the observation window
fields that cannot hold a canary string, including enumerations, booleans, and numbers
destructive actions and fixed state transitions such as delete, cancel, and approve

revisit_triggers: a fixture cannot kill one numbered check
a supported result can be produced without the stated predicate
a new claim class is incorrectly accepted by either v1 template
a target requires a non-string or non-object effect currently listed as a known miss
